entries.cmd: oc expose service web --name=web-internal --hostname=web.shard.apps-crc.testing -n lab-ingress
for i in $(seq 1 30); do oc get route web-internal -n lab-ingress -o jsonpath='{.status.ingress[*].routerName}' | grep -qw default && break; sleep 2; done; sleep 5
oc get route web-internal -n lab-ingress -o jsonpath='{range .status.ingress[*]}{.routerName}{"\t"}{.conditions[0].type}={.conditions[0].status}{"\n"}{end}'
oc exec deploy/client -n lab-ingress -- curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H 'Host: web.shard.apps-crc.testing' http://router-internal-academy-shard.openshift-ingress.svc/
oc label route web-internal shard=academy -n lab-ingress
for i in $(seq 1 30); do oc get route web-internal -n lab-ingress -o jsonpath='{.status.ingress[*].routerName}' | grep -qw academy-shard && break; sleep 2; done; sleep 5
oc get route web-internal -n lab-ingress -o yaml
